steps.caption: Settings is at the bottom of the sidebar (owners and admins).
Owners must set up an authenticator app before admin pages — CRE OS never sends codes by SMS or email.
Tabs: General, Members, Partners, Templates, Licensed sources, Data lanes, Retention, Security.
Read-only: CRE OS cannot send email, change your calendar or delete anything.
Microsoft 365: reads mail and calendar with Mail.Read and Calendars.Read only.
'Permissions requested' lists exactly what it asks for.
Google (Gmail & Calendar): same read-only rules. Until set up, import threads by hand in Drafts → Inbox triage.
'Use mock data' lets you try it without connecting a real account.
Urgent alerts: private notes to you only, for verified senders. Off by default.
Choose which events alert you, and a do-not-disturb window.
Nothing is ever sent to a client automatically — drafts only, you send them yourself.
